Production Glossary · 05/50 · planning

Creative treatment

Definition

Creative treatment is a narrative and visual proposal that translates a brief into a coherent creative direction before production. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align planning decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.
